profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Airbnb
profile.summary:
I have a passion for problem solving, collaborating with people to come up with great ideas, and an eagerness to explore new technologies. I'm transitioning from a career in print technologies to software engineering! 

Life isn't all about work. I love spending time with my husband and two young sons, family, and friends. I also enjoy exploring the Bay Area, running, throwing pottery, and solving code puzzles.  Year around you'll find me cheering for my favorite Tigers. Go Clemson!

positions.title: Print Production Coordinator
positions.description: I follow every project from concept to finished product. I ensure that the client's concept is feasible from a print perspective and help the account managers and production manager with any technical challenges that may arise.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
As a technical support representative, I wear many hats and no two days are ever the same. A few of the major tasks I do for the plate side of Sun Chemical is:
- co-manage customer on-boarding by evaluating print samples and making recommendations for plate type, screening technologies, and how to treat the art during prepress. 
-serve as customer coordinator and oversee the order process to help ensure that all plates are delivered on time and print to the customer's expectations
-solve customer plate or print issues
-attend press checks
-evaluate new plate technologies and how best to leverage them into our process

positions.title: New Product/Application Development
positions.description:
Research developing technologies and help benchmark recent commercial products for MacDermid.
Work with other customers, co-suppliers, and colleges on various collaborative projects for research and marketing purposes.

positions.title: Technical Service Intern
positions.description: Made plates for customers and helped test plate specification for the Technical Service department.

positions.title: Beverage Division Intern
positions.description: Preflighted incoming files and used Adobe Illustrator to generate digital proofs for customers.

educations.schoolName: Wilbur O. and Ann Powers College of Business at Clemson University
